view_frame: The drawing uses third-angle projection with three views: BOTTOM (XY), TOP (XY), and FRONT (XZ). The world coordinate system is defined with X as width (left-right), Y as depth (front-back), and Z as height (up-down). The FRONT view displays the XZ plane, showing the vertical profile and height. The TOP and BOTTOM views display the XY plane, showing the cross-sectional shapes at the top and bottom respectively.

features.placement: Centered at (0,0) in the XY plane. Extends from X=-30 to X=30 and Y=-20 to Y=20.
features.evidence: BOTTOM (XY) view shows a rectangle labeled '60 x 40 mm rectangle'.

features.placement: Centered at (0,0) in the XY plane. Radius is 15 mm.
features.evidence: TOP (XY) view shows a circle labeled 'diameter 30 mm'.

features.placement: Solid volume connecting the rectangular_base at Z=0 to the circular_top at Z=60. The profiles are parallel XY planes sharing the same XY center (0,0).
features.evidence: FRONT (XZ) view shows a trapezoid connecting the wider bottom to the narrower top, labeled 'height 60 mm; solid'. The notes confirm 'Solid transition piece'.

connections: The rectangular_base and circular_top are connected by the transition_body loft.
The transition_body connects the perimeter of the rectangular_base to the perimeter of the circular_top.
edit_rules: Changing the rectangular_base width or depth updates the bottom profile of the transition_body.
Changing the circular_top diameter updates the top profile of the transition_body.
Changing the height updates the Z position of the circular_top and the vertical extent of the transition_body.
The transition_body maintains a straight linear interpolation between the bottom and top profiles.
